# comic-dl

> A command-line downloader for comics and manga. Download from supported
> sites and package into CBZ, ZIP, or CBT archives.

- Docs: https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/
- Source: https://github.com/fallen020/comic-dl
- Releases (binaries, no Python needed): https://github.com/fallen020/comic-dl/releases

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/introduction/): What comic-dl is, what it does, and whether it fits your setup.
- [Installation](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/installation/): Install comic-dl from a release binary or from source.
- [Quick Start](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/quick-start/): Install comic-dl, download a gallery, and read the archive it produces.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/faq/): Quick answers about reader compatibility, installation, chapter selection, resume, and configuration.
- [API Reference](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/api-reference/): Find Python modules for data models, scraping, downloads, archives, configuration, and errors.

## Configure

- [Configuration File](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/configure/config/): Save download defaults in TOML, resolve option precedence, and manage per-host settings.
- [Cookies & Anti-Bot Handling](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/configure/cookies/): Understand cookie storage, session lifetimes, and the available HTTP settings.
- [Environment Variables](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/configure/environment/): Configure paths, terminal colors, diagnostics, and display settings through environment variables.
- [Rate Limiting](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/configure/rate-limiting/): Set per-host request rates and understand how throttling interacts with concurrency and retries.

## Usage

- [Downloading](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/usage/basic/): Every way to download content with comic-dl — single URLs, URL files, chapter selection, and scripting.
- [Library Management](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/usage/library/): List downloaded series, check recent chapters, update subscriptions, and remove or restore series.
- [Output & Archives](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/usage/output/): Find downloaded files, choose an archive format, and understand metadata, deduplication, and resume.
- [Metadata](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/usage/metadata/): See which ComicInfo.xml fields are written inside archives and beside them, with per-site mappings.
- [Plugins](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/usage/plugins/): Install and inspect third-party sources, validate plugins, and understand priority and trust boundaries.
- [Writing a Plugin](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/usage/write-plugin/): Implement a source, return chapter and series metadata, and register a plugin package.

## Reference

- [CLI Reference](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/reference/cli/): Every command and flag in comic-dl, plus JSON output and exit codes.
- [Exit Codes](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/reference/exit-codes/): Interpret process exit codes, classify failures, and handle interruptions or mixed batch results in scripts.
- [Supported Sites](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/reference/supported-sites/): The 13 built-in scrapers supported by comic-dl, their URL patterns, and per-site notes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/troubleshooting/): Common comic-dl failures — blocked access, missing pages, rate limits — and how to fix them.

## Develop

- [Architecture](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/develop/architecture/): Follow the download pipeline, module boundaries, concurrency model, and extension points.
- [Testing](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/develop/testing/): Run the offline test suite, find relevant tests, and check coverage when contributing.
- [Error Style Guide](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/develop/error-style-guide/): Write actionable errors with consistent wording, output streams, exit codes, and diagnostics.
- [Security Testing](https://fallen020.github.io/comic-dl/docs/develop/security-testing/): Run offline checks for network, filesystem, database, and parser safety, and review known limits.
